description: Ivosidenib plus azacitidine is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for untreated acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) with an IDH1 R132 mutation in adults who cannot have standard intensive induction chemotherapy. It is only recommended if the company provides it according to the commercial arrangement.
